auth.enterCode: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app for {{name}}.
auth.lostPhone: Lost your phone? Use a backup code
auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.
auth.welcomeDesc: Create the first profile. You'll be the admin and can add the rest of your family afterwards.
auth.noRecovery: Your password can't be recovered. You can turn on two-step verification and biometric unlock in Settings.
auth.setupDesc: Enter the setup code an admin gave you, then choose your own password.

language.title: Language and region

language.currencyHint: Used for new accounts and totals. Each account keeps its own currency.

profile.desc: Only you can see your accounts and transactions.
profile.name: Name

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.desc: Theme and accent colour for this device
appearance.hideDesc: Mask amounts everywhere until toggled off (Ctrl/Cmd+H)
appearance.motionDesc: How much the interface moves. Reduced keeps gentle fades and is used automatically when your system asks for less motion.
appearance.motionSystem: Your system is set to reduce motion, so Vaulty uses Reduced.

tax.private: Figures you enter here stay on this page and aren't saved.
tax.unsupported: Tax rules for {{country}} aren't in Vaulty yet
tax.unsupportedBody: Each country's rules are a data file anyone can add. Until yours arrives, you can try another country's planner.
tax.otherHint: Interest, rent and other income taxed at normal rates. Capital gains aren't included yet.
tax.enterIncome: Enter your income to compare regimes
tax.same: Both regimes come to the same tax
tax.choiceNote: You choose the regime when you file your return.
tax.disclaimer: An estimate for planning, not tax advice. Rules last checked {{date}}.

ticker.label: Market prices
ticker.empty: No prices yet. Choose what to show in Settings.

market.title: Market ticker
market.desc: A strip of live prices under the header.
market.privacy: Vaulty goes online only to fetch these prices. It sends the symbols you choose and nothing about your money.
market.providerNoneHint: Stock prices need a free key from a market data provider. Crypto prices work without one.
market.twelveHint: Get a free key at twelvedata.com. Free plans cover fewer exchanges and 8 symbols a minute, so long lists fill in over a few refreshes.
market.cryptoKeyHint: Prices work without a key; a free demo key from coingecko.com avoids busy-hour limits.

recovery.title: Save your recovery key
recovery.body: Your data is encrypted. If you forget your password, this key is the only way back in. Nobody else, not even a family admin, can recover it for you.
recovery.bodyChild: Your data is encrypted. If you forget your password, this key gets you back in, or a parent can reset it for you.
recovery.where: Write it down or keep it in a password manager, somewhere other than this device.
recovery.clipboardNote: The clipboard is cleared after a minute.
recovery.confirm: I've saved my recovery key somewhere safe
recovery.recoverDesc: Enter the recovery key you saved when you set up this profile, then choose a new password.
recovery.childHint: No recovery key? A parent can reset your password from the Family page.
recovery.adultHint: No recovery key? An admin can only erase this profile and start it over; the data can't be recovered without your password or key.

history.title: History
history.keep: Every change you make is recorded in your encrypted data. Deleted items can be restored for 30 days; changes stay in history for 90 days.
history.emptyTrash: Nothing deleted in the last 30 days.
history.blocked: Can't undo: this item was changed again later. Undo the later change first.

transaction.visibility: Changed who can see a transaction

check.intactBody_one: {{count}} change checked since {{date}}. Nothing was altered or removed, and nothing was changed outside Vaulty.
check.intactBody_other: {{count}} changes checked since {{date}}. Nothing was altered or removed, and nothing was changed outside Vaulty.
check.brokenBody: Change {{id}}: {{reason}}. Someone may have edited Vaulty's data directly. Restore a safety copy from Settings if you didn't expect this.
check.outsideBody_one: {{count}} item was changed without going through Vaulty, so it has no history entry.
check.outsideBody_other: {{count}} items were changed without going through Vaulty, so they have no history entry.
check.fingerprintHint: Each change carries a fingerprint of the one before it, so altering or removing any change breaks every fingerprint after it. Note this one down (or give it to your accountant) to prove later that history wasn't rewritten.
check.unchained_one: {{count}} older change from before fingerprints were added isn't covered.
check.unchained_other: {{count}} older changes from before fingerprints were added aren't covered.

snapshots.title: Safety copies
snapshots.desc: Encrypted copies of your data on this device: one a day, and one before every import, update and restore.
snapshots.empty: No copies yet. One is made when you sign in each day.
snapshots.confirmBody: Your data goes back to how it was on {{date}}. Your current data is saved as a copy first, so you can switch back.
snapshots.note: These protect against mistakes, not against losing this device. For that, export a backup and keep it somewhere else.
snapshots.keep: Up to 7 daily and 4 weekly copies are kept.

hidden.hideSwitchDesc: Only the amount shows in your main list. Hidden transactions are never shared with family.
hidden.lockedDesc: Kept out of your main list, where only their amounts show. Confirm it's you to see the details.
hidden.unlockSystem: Use Touch ID or Windows Hello
hidden.empty: Nothing hidden yet. Use the eye button on any transaction to move it here.
hidden.maskedHint: Hidden details. Open the Hidden tab to see them.
hidden.pref: Hidden transactions in the main list
hidden.prefDesc: Dashboard totals and balances include them either way.

demo.badgeTitle: Sample data in a temporary folder. It's rebuilt each time Vaulty starts in demo mode.
demo.picker: Demo mode: three sample profiles with made-up data. Nothing here is real, and it's rebuilt every launch.

accounts.cardNote: Card balances count against your net worth.
accounts.empty: No accounts yet. Add your bank, cash or card accounts to start tracking.
accounts.notImage: That file isn't an image Vaulty can read.

tx.sharingOff: Family sharing is off, so this stays private until you turn it on in Settings.
tx.noOneYet: You haven't picked anyone to share with yet (Settings → Family sharing).

hint.prepaid: Prepaid, forex or transit cards with their own balance
hint.gift: Store gift cards with the value left on them

cards.tiltHint: Move over the card to tilt it. Click it to turn it over.
cards.notesEmpty: Add notes like a membership number or renewal date.
cards.setDue: Set a due day to see the countdown
cards.addCycle: Edit the card to add its billing cycle.
cards.under30: Keeping credit used under 30% of the limit is generally better for your credit score.
cards.emptyHint: Keep credit, debit, prepaid, gift and membership cards together, each with its own look.
cards.removeOwns: The card and its balance account are archived. Past transactions stay in your history and reports.
cards.removeDebit: Only the card is removed. {{account}} and its transactions stay as they are.
cards.removeOther: The card and its notes are removed.
cards.privacy: Only the card network and last 4 digits are saved. The full number never leaves this form.
cards.name: Card name
cards.needBank: Add a bank account on the Accounts page first.
cards.issuingBank: Issuing bank (optional, defaults to the account's bank)
cards.numberPh: Type it, or just the last 4 digits
cards.detectHint: Network is detected as you type
cards.luhn: That number doesn't look valid. Check for a typo; only the last 4 digits are saved either way.
cards.changeOwed: To change the amount owed, add a transaction to the card's account.
cards.changeBalance: To change the balance, add a transaction to the card's account.
cards.keepsLast4: Vaulty keeps only the last 4 digits of this card.

look.cropped: Cropped to card shape. Stays on this device.

institution.noMatch: No match. You can leave this empty.

members.intro: Everyone gets a separate, private profile with their own password. Admins manage who's on this device but can't open other members' data: each profile is encrypted with its own key. Parents can reset a child's password without losing the child's data.
members.addDesc: You'll get a one-time setup code to give them. They'll use it to choose their own password.

roleDesc.admin: Can also add and remove members and reset children's passwords. Can't open other adults' data.
roleDesc.child: For kids. Parents can reset their password without losing their data.

members.codeDesc: On the sign-in screen, {{name}} picks their profile, enters this code and chooses a password. It works once and expires in 7 days.

reset.title: Reset {{name}}'s password?
reset.body: You hold a parent's recovery copy of {{name}}'s key, so their data is kept. Their password, two-step verification and biometric unlock are cleared, and you get a new setup code for them.

newcode.title: New setup code for {{name}}?
newcode.body: The old code stops working. This profile hasn't been set up yet, so there's no data to lose.

erase.title: Erase {{name}}'s data and start over?
erase.body: {{name}}'s data is encrypted with their own password and recovery key, and no admin can open it. If they've lost both, the only way forward is to delete everything in their profile and issue a new setup code. This can't be undone. If they still have their recovery key, they should use "Forgot password?" on the sign-in screen instead.

remove.title: Remove {{name}} from Vaulty?
remove.body: This permanently deletes their profile and all of their financial data on this device. Make sure they've exported a backup first.

hint.all: Everything you can see: your shared and public items, plus what others share with you

family.offTitle: Family sharing is off for you
family.offBody: Turn it on to see the expenses your family chooses to share, and to share yours. Each person decides for themselves; nothing is shared until they do.
family.noShared: Nothing shared for this month yet.

sharing.title: Family sharing
sharing.desc: Share chosen expenses with your family, and see what they share with you. Nothing is shared until you turn this on.
sharing.notReady: The family store is encrypted with a shared key. You'll get it the next time another family member signs in on this device.
sharing.privateText: Only you. The default for everything.
sharing.sharedText: You plus the people you pick below, e.g. parents.
sharing.publicText: Everyone in the family who has sharing on.
sharing.defaultHint: You can still change it for each transaction.
sharing.who: Who can see your Shared items
sharing.noOthers: No other family members on this device yet.
sharing.offFor: Sharing off · won't see it until they turn it on
sharing.withdraw: Turning this off withdraws everything you've shared, immediately.

security.totpDesc: You'll need a code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Aegis, 1Password…) each time you sign in with your password.
security.scanDesc: Then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
security.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
security.manualKey: Can't scan? Enter this key manually
security.saveCodesDesc: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you sign in once. They won't be shown again.
security.codesFileNote: Each code works once. Keep them somewhere safe.
security.title: Sign-in & security
security.desc: These settings apply only to your profile.
security.twoStepOff: Ask for a code from an authenticator app after your password.
security.bioUnavailable: Not available on this device yet.
security.bioOn: On for this device. Skips password and 2FA here.
security.bioOff: Unlock without typing your password on this device.
security.recoveryChild: Unlocks your data if you forget your password. A parent can also reset it for you.
security.recoveryAdult: Unlocks your data if you forget your password. Nobody else can recover your data, so keep it somewhere safe.
security.autoLockDesc: After this long without using Vaulty on this device, or when you come back to it.
security.newKeyDesc: Your current recovery key stops working. You'll see the new one once, so have somewhere ready to save it.
security.totpOffDesc: Your password alone will unlock your profile, and your backup codes will stop working.
security.genDesc: Your old backup codes will stop working.
security.bioDesc: Confirm your password, then approve the {{method}} prompt. Anyone who can pass {{method}} on this computer will be able to open your profile.
security.newCodesDesc: Each works once. They won't be shown again.
